server.name: Channel3
server.title: Channel3 Shopping
server.description: Shopping search across 100M+ products, with every retailer's offer and live price in one place.

live.instructions:
Use Channel3 to search products and compare live retailer offers.
Call search_products separately for each distinct product type.
Call get_products for full details by product ID or retailer URL.
Results appear in a storefront UI — comment or recommend; do not re-list what the user can see.
For deictic references ("this product"), use the storefront model context.
Every Channel3 result includes a thread_id — always pass it back unchanged as thread_id on every subsequent Channel3 call in the same conversation, even for unrelated searches.

tools.name: search_products
tools.title: Search Products
tools.description:
Search 100M+ products across thousands of retailers for one product type. Call once for each distinct product type, and send independent calls together. Put relevant constraints in `query`.
Returns up to 8 product cards plus structured product data. The result includes a `thread_id`. You MUST include it unchanged as the `thread_id` parameter on every subsequent Channel3 tool call in this conversation — including searches for new, unrelated products. Never omit it once you have one.

query.description:
One product type and its constraints in natural language (brand, color, material, size, price, gender).
Good: "red leather jacket under $200"; "leather golf glove under $40".
Bad: "gift ideas for dad"; "cool sneakers"; "golf glove or rangefinder".

image_url.description: Public image URL for visual search. Combine with `query` for text + image.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Omit ONLY on the very first Channel3 call of a conversation. From then on, always pass the `thread_id` from the most recent Channel3 result, unchanged — even when the new call is a completely different product search.

query.description: The text query this result answers.

image_url.description: The image URL this result answers.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token used by the storefront UI; not usable via this tool.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp of when this result was produced; prices are live as of this moment.

session_id.description: PostHog MCP session ID for analytics correlation.

server_origin.description: Origin of this MCP server; the storefront UI posts analytics events here.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Pass it back unchanged as `thread_id` on every follow-up call in this conversation.

tools.name: get_products
tools.title: Get Products
tools.description:
Get full product data (offers, description, attributes, images) by product ID from a search result, or by retailer URL. Pass several IDs in one call to compare.
Use search_products to find products. Returns details in the storefront UI. The result includes a `thread_id`. You MUST include it unchanged as the `thread_id` parameter on every subsequent Channel3 tool call in this conversation — including searches for new, unrelated products. Never omit it once you have one.

items.description: Product ID (from a `search_products` result) or URL.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Omit ONLY on the very first Channel3 call of a conversation. From then on, always pass the `thread_id` from the most recent Channel3 result, unchanged — even when the new call is a completely different product search.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp of when this result was produced; prices are live as of this moment.

session_id.description: PostHog MCP session ID for analytics correlation.

server_origin.description: Origin of this MCP server; the storefront UI posts analytics events here.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Pass it back unchanged as `thread_id` on every follow-up call in this conversation.
